summary.text: Pooja Sethi is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Jennifer Mushtaler in a race with no incumbent.
She is an attorney and small business owner who has served as chief of staff to state Representative Vikki Goodwin and as chair of the Travis County Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Sethi earned a B.A. from George Washington University and a J.D. from Syracuse University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was chief of staff for House District 47 for more than four years and is a practicing attorney.
Sethi won the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, receiving 76.1% of the vote to Joseph Kopser's 23.9%.
In the survey, she said she is focused on strengthening public schools, expanding access to health care, improving water and wildfire infrastructure, and addressing everyday affordability.
